answer: Sybils splitting into many identities must pay the stake and compute cost per identity, while honest agents reach the summit of reputation cheaply. Each agent must stake tokens and complete a proof-of-work challenge seeded by the prior epoch's block hash, forming an unbroken thread of verifiable history. Colluding clusters get flagged when their behavioral fingerprint falls into a narrow canyon of near-identical timing, making mass fake accounts economically irrational. In practice, Agent0040 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
